limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (bitwise AND of the two matched amounts is zero)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching

zero_cost_guard_triggered.meaning: the zero-cost trade guard triggers (rejects the trade) even though neither side receives tokens without sending any
zero_cost_guard_triggered.checkpoint: during limit order matching when the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated

legitimate_trade_fails_misleading_error.meaning: a legitimate trade fails with a misleading error
legitimate_trade_fails_misleading_error.checkpoint: after the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching

claims.scope: This causes legitimate trades to fail with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency.

preconditions.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.; The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The zero-cost trade guard should trigger only when one side receives tokens without sending any, not merely when amounts have disjoint bits.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: This causes legitimate trades to fail with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is the check whose triggering rejects the trade during limit order matching.
A trade in which neither side receives tokens without sending any is a legitimate trade that should complete.

limitations: The disjoint-bits condition is encoded as a single grounded Boolean because the report gives only illustrative examples (base = 256, quote in 1..255; 40 & 21) and not the exact matched-amount operands.
The misleading-error wording is captured by the legitimate_trade_fails_misleading_error Boolean; no specific error string is stated in the report.
